relations.text: Fortinetの年次報告は、機器の限定供給部品としてWestern Digital製のメモリ機器を挙げている
relations.text_en: Fortinet's annual report lists memory devices from Western Digital among its limited source components

source.label: Fortinet 10-K
source.quote: Our limited source components for particular appliances and suppliers of those components include specific types of CPUs from Intel and AMD, network and wireless chips from Broadcom, Marvell, Qualcomm and Intel, and memory devices from Intel, Micron, ADATA, Toshiba, Samsung and Western Digital.

companies.sub: フラッシュストレージ

relations.text: Sandiskの年次報告は、Western Digitalの債務についてSandiskが引き受け補償する旨を述べ、分離・配布契約を挙げている
relations.text_en: Sandisk's annual report says it agreed to assume and indemnify WDC for certain liabilities, referencing the Separation and Distribution Agreement

source.label: Sandisk 10-K
source.quote: we have agreed to assume, and indemnify WDC for, certain liabilities, as discussed further in the section of this annual report on Form 10-K entitled “Transactions with Western Digital Corporation—Separation and Distribution Agreement and Other Transactions with WDC.” Third parties could also seek to hold us responsible for liabilities that WDC has

relations.text: Western Digitalは分離時にSandiskの株式を配布した
relations.text_en: Western Digital distributed Sandisk shares at the Separation

source.label: Western Digital 10-K
source.quote: The graph assumes that $100 was invested in our common stock at the close of market on July 2, 2021 and that all dividends, including the distribution of Sandisk shares at Separation, were reinvested.

relations.text: Western DigitalはSandiskを、同社のプラットフォーム向けにSSDの認定を済ませた提供元の1社に挙げている
relations.text_en: Western Digital lists Sandisk among providers whose SSDs it has qualified for its platforms

source.label: Western Digital の発表
source.quote: Western Digital’s Platforms business now offers customers enhanced flexibility and choice in building their storage infrastructure. By supporting a multi-SSD vendor strategy, Western Digital has currently qualified SSDs with leading providers such as DapuStor, Kioxia, Phison, Sandisk and ScaleFlux with additional vendors in the qualification process.
source.note: 認定の記載で、供給量は示されていません。
source.note_en: Qualification only; no supply volume is stated.

relations.text: Western Digitalは、保有するSandisk株1,038,681株を今後の交換や配当で処分する意向である
relations.text_en: Western Digital will continue to own 1,038,681 shares of Sandisk common stock and intends to dispose of them in later exchanges or distributions

source.label: Western Digital の発表
source.quote: Upon the settlement of the exchanges, WD will continue to own 1,038,681 shares of Sandisk common stock, which it intends to dispose of in one or more subsequent exchanges for WD debt held by WD creditors and/or in exchange for outstanding shares of WD common stock and/or through distributions to WD stockholders as dividends.

relations.text: KioxiaおよびUnis Ventureとの合弁事業はすべて、分離に際してSandiskに配布された
relations.text_en: All business ventures with Kioxia and Unis Venture were distributed to Sandisk in connection with the Separation

source.label: Western Digital 10-K
source.quote: All business ventures with Kioxia and Unis Venture were distributed to Sandisk in connection with the Separation and are included in discontinued operations.
source.note: 分離によりSandiskへ移管済みです。
source.note_en: Transferred to Sandisk in the Separation.

relations.text: Rambusの年次報告は、Western Digitalを同社の特許のライセンスを受けた企業の1社に挙げている

source.label: Rambus 10-K
source.quote: Leading semiconductor and electronic system companies, such as AMD, Amlogic, Broadcom, CXMT, IBM, Infineon, Kioxia, Marvell, MediaTek, Micron, Nanya, Nuvoton, NVIDIA, Phison, Qualcomm, Samsung, Silicon Motion, SK hynix, Socionext, STMicroelectronics, Toshiba, Western Digital and Winbond have licensed our patents.

companies.name: シーゲイト・テクノロジー

relations.text: ウエスタンデジタルの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in Western Digital’s annual report

source.label: Western Digital 10-K
source.quote: Our competitors include HDD competitors such as Seagate Technology Holdings plc, and Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation along with NAND flash suppliers that provide and enable alternative storage technologies, as well as storage systems and solutions providers.

relations.text: シーゲイト・テクノロジーの年次報告が、ウエスタンデジタルを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Western Digital as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Seagate Technology 10-K
source.quote: Our global competitors include HDD manufacturers such as Western Digital Corporation and Toshiba Electronics Devices & Storage Corporation along with NAND flash suppliers that provide and enable alternative storage technologies, as well as storage systems and solutions providers.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
